title: Unified Global Retail Configuration Management
business: A global retail chain managing Kubernetes clusters across multiple regional data centers.
problem: The engineering team faces significant operational overhead due to maintaining duplicated YAML manifests for each region, leading to configuration drift and manual error-prone updates when applying environment-specific patches.
solution: Kustomize enables a template-free approach by utilizing a base directory containing common resource definitions, while regional overlays apply environment-specific patches and strategic merges without modifying the original source files.
steps: Define a base directory containing standard deployment and service YAML files.
Create regional overlay directories for each deployment target.
Define a kustomization.yaml file in each overlay to reference the base.
Apply environment-specific patches or common labels within the overlay kustomization files.
Execute kubectl apply -k to generate and deploy the final merged configuration.
outcome: The team achieves a single source of truth for base configurations while maintaining the flexibility to inject regional requirements, significantly reducing configuration drift and manual maintenance effort.
limitation: Kustomize does not support complex conditional logic or looping constructs found in templating engines; verify configuration state by running kubectl kustomize to inspect the final rendered output before applying.

questions.question: In Unified Global Retail Configuration Management, how does Kustomize address the problem of configuration drift?
options: By using template-free overlays to patch a single base configuration.
By converting all YAML files into a proprietary binary format.
By automatically rewriting the base files for every region.
By requiring a separate Git repository for every regional cluster.
questions.explanation: Kustomize uses a base and overlay structure to manage configurations without modifying the original source, which prevents drift.
questions.evidence: Kustomize enables a template-free approach by utilizing a base directory containing common resource definitions, while regional overlays apply environment-specific patches and strategic merges without modifying the original source files.

questions.question: In Unified Global Retail Configuration Management, what is a primary limitation of the Kustomize approach?
options: It requires a custom plugin for every Kubernetes resource type.
It cannot handle more than two overlay layers at a time.
It lacks support for complex conditional logic or looping constructs.
It is incompatible with the kubectl apply command.
questions.explanation: Kustomize is designed to be template-free and declarative, meaning it avoids the complexity of logic-heavy templating engines.
questions.evidence: Kustomize does not support complex conditional logic or looping constructs found in templating engines; verify configuration state by running kubectl kustomize to inspect the final rendered output before applying.
